title.rendered: School Supply List is Now Available!

content.rendered:
Listed below are the imperative school supplies students need when they attend school.  Most other supplies have been purchased by teachers and are available for student use.  Of course, students are always welcome to buy supplies to keep independently if they prefer. For a printable version of this list, please see the link at the bottom of this page.

Each Student Needs:

  • Pencils (and LOTS of them)
  • 2-3 highlighters
  • Colored pencils
  • Binder/folders to hold papers going to and from school each day
  • Personal novel
  • Refillable water bottle

Additionally, students will need the following supplies by course subject:

Language Arts:

  • Composition notebook
  • Post-it note package

Social Studies:

  • Composition notebook
  • Red, blue, green ink pen
  • Sheet protector

Math:

  • Quadrille-ruled spiral notebook
  • Composition or spiral notebook (only 8th grade)
  • T1-30 calculator (or something similar)

Science:

  • Composition notebook

PE:

  • Shorts and a t-shirt appropriate for activities – optional (Note: Changing into PE-specific clothing is optional for all students; students who choose not to dress down for PE should plan to wear clothing to school that allows them to participate fully in PE activities)
  • Athletic shoes

Optional Donation Supplies for Teachers:

  • Pencils
  • Highlighters
  • Post-it notes
  • Sharpies
  • Clorox wipes
  • Kleenex
  • Sanitizer
